query: Vince Phillips held a junior welterweight title by an organization recognized by what larger Hall of Fame?

repl_history.response:
The [Global Context Preview] shows that "Vince Phillips held the IBF junior welterweight title from 1997 to 1999." It also states that "The International Boxing Federation (IBF) is one of four major organizations recognized by the International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF) which sanction world championship boxing bouts, alongside the World Boxing Association (WBA), World Boxing Council (WBC) and World Boxing Organization (WBO)."

This information directly answers the query. The IBF is an organization recognized by the larger International Boxing Hall of Fame.

FINAL ANSWER: IBHOF
